references.author: https://x.com/elayadesigns
references.observed: Split headline and description over an oval portrait strip. Clouds move across the background over 4.31 seconds.
references.adaptation: Keep the split hierarchy and oval portrait rhythm; use curated Pexels portraits with a short CSS entrance instead of the original illustrated cloud scene.

references.author: https://x.com/moguzbulbul
references.observed: Centered title and two CTAs; stepped rectangular masks reveal an overlapping product window over four seconds.
references.adaptation: Use a real HTML product composition with a finite CSS entrance and stepped backplates.

references.author: https://x.com/noechague
references.observed: A category menu filters a compact two-column module directory. A featured module expands above the results; a search overlay appears later.
references.adaptation: Implement category filtering with native radios and :has(). Omit the JavaScript search overlay.

references.author: https://x.com/colton__tollett
references.observed: A narrow central stream of computer photos bends at the viewport edges; year and product name sit on either side. The stream reverses with scroll.
references.adaptation: Use a vertical photo timeline with progressive CSS view-timeline transforms and a readable static fallback; no nested vertical scroll area.

references.author: https://x.com/ahmetloca
references.observed: Full-bleed interior imagery changes with scroll. Oversized outlined chapter words surround the current solid chapter number.
references.adaptation: Use full-width technology/workspace photo chapters, oversized numbering and progressive scroll motion; retain normal document scrolling.

references.author: https://x.com/typeui_sh
references.observed: The full-site clip includes three workflow columns: Ask with context, Trace the logic, Share the decision, followed by a split explanation section around 20–24 seconds.
references.adaptation: Recreate this section only: three linked steps and a split explainer with native disclosure and CSS diagram treatments.

references.author: https://x.com/juli_fella
references.observed: Three pricing tiers under a monthly/yearly selector. The center tier is emphasized; amounts animate when billing changes.
references.adaptation: Use real native radio billing selection, correct totals and transitions. Mark all plans as demonstration content.

references.author: https://x.com/adamhmwn
references.observed: A left heading remains in place beside four colored process panels. Listen, Plan, Build and Ship reveal a line illustration and description as the cursor moves.
references.adaptation: Use native details/summary for explicit keyboard and touch activation; preserve the four-panel visual rhythm.

references.author: https://x.com/emirayaz
references.observed: A centered quotation and byline switch with a row of small overlapping portraits; the selected portrait rises above its neighbors.
references.adaptation: Use native radio selectors with CSS-only quotation switching and raised selected portraits. Quotes and names are clearly examples.

references.author: https://x.com/socoloffalex
references.observed: A large two-line heading sits over a horizontally draggable row of broad testimonial cards.
references.adaptation: Use native horizontal scrolling and scroll snap, accessible from the keyboard, with clearly labeled sample quotations.
